body:
getargspec is used in SQLAlchemy for:

- the signature-matching decorate function that is used only on internal functions

- format_argspec_init which is used on end-user mapped __init__ methods

- many many places in langhelpers

So to consider a full port to Signature, note that there is a Py2.7 package:

https://pypi.org/project/funcsigs/

written by some of the usual suspects, so this might be what we have to do

**Mike Bayer** has proposed a fix for this issue in the **master** branch:

**Use fully vendored getfullargspec** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/1286

**Mike Bayer** has proposed a fix for this issue in the **rel_1_3** branch:

**Use fully vendored getfullargspec** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/1287
